# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands (iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods)

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, about $98 list, $80-90 at retailers**
WIRED's top pick. It has a chrome stand, 15W Qi2 for the iPhone, fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and a pad for AirPods. The phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. The power supply is included and there's a 2-year warranty. WIRED lists it at Amazon and Best Buy, with buy links in their guide: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max, $169**
It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone and has a heavy base you can lift your phone off one-handed. No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one (WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter, $25). Details and buy link: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station, about $40 (list $80) on Amazon**
It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. It charges the phone at 15W and includes a charger and cable. The Apple Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back, and WIRED lost the cap right away. The warranty is only 1 year. Link: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best for a desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W, $129.99**
Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested, lifting the phone over 70mm with a 160° hinge. It comes with a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. It weighs 399g, which is heavy next to rivals. Review: https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html

**Best compact travel pick: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80**
It folds slim, charges at 15W, and has a 2-year warranty. Link: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/

**Other options**
- **ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W), $99.99:** It adds a cooling fan, which can be switched off for sleeping, and includes a 50W adapter. One deal site lists a code (PARTNER18) taking $17.99 off at ESR's store. I can't verify that, so check at checkout. It's an affiliate page: https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand
- **Nimble Podium, $130:** Your devices lie flat, which suits a dark bedroom. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best overnight. Link: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**How to choose**
- 25W only applies to newer iPhones. The ESR page says it's limited to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus, and Macworld says iPhone 16 and 17 in general. Older iPhones get 15W. If you charge overnight, WIRED says 25W makes little difference, so the Belkin or ESR 15W is enough.
- Your AirPods case must support wireless charging for the third pad to work.

If you tell me your iPhone model and budget, I can narrow it to one.
